notes.title: Journal update
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]Journal Update[/b]: You can now review all your past choices by clicking the header at the top of the screen — perfect for catching up on story you might’ve skipped by an accidental click.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Creation[/b]: Couple of minor improvements for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prologue[/b]: Slight polish and a hidden achievement added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Clicks are no longer registered when the game is inactive — such as during alt+tab or in windowed mode.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Settings update, various bug fixes
notes.notes: [p][b]Update Highlights:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sound Settings:[/b] You can now adjust the master volume, music, button sounds, and other sound effects independently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics Settings:[/b] You can now disable background images entirely — for players who prefer a simpler interface or just like things a bit more... minimalist.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Shops in Skjalaborg are working again. Sorry for the inconvenience![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Battle special conditions update
notes.notes: [p]I've just released another small update for the demo! Until now, most battles felt quite similar, and many of you likely stuck with just one weapon. That’s about to change — from now on, many encounters come with special conditions that grant bonuses or penalties to certain skills.[/p][p]For example, fighting in a shield wall formation gives you a bonus to shield and spear skills. So be sure to adapt — swap your weapon to match the situation and make the most of every battle![/p]

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.notes: [p]While you wait for the full release, you can enjoy a demo featuring an upgraded UI, improved dialogues, updated tutorial, and plenty of small quality of life changes — like being able to change your equipment while in a shop, making it easier to sell old gear and afford new items.[/p][p]Combat has been rebalanced for a more enjoyable experience, with numerous tweaks to equipment, attacks, and enemies. And of course, countless bugs have been squashed along the way.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525018/65787561553e0fd57592f54677d1a4d147028861.png"][/img][/p]
